summary: 09:25 wake (Sonnet), dev at c9b8129d1024, no notes, no new messages. No catch; desk.json not changed. The note could say so in one clause (a note to story-site; not edited by me). The hold stands: the vault still holds only the 22 October Palo Alto PSIRT capture (717 sources, 07:13 UTC on 31 October), no Unit 42 brief of 29 October; PAN-OS stays off the site; stamps stay at 09:42 UTC on 30 October and the readers' lines are unchanged. No new state of affairs version. Outstanding: curator's capture of the Unit 42 and Palo Alto primaries (two days now; the editor may want to ask); batches 23 to 26 mostly not rechecked, batch 30's 19 noted verdicts only read; updates has no journalist commits; refs and press not attached; dev's proposal on signed logs to the press awaits the editor.
